name: laravel/laravel
description: The skeleton application for the Laravel framework.

dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74,#818cf8" "composer run serve:dev" "composer run queue:dev" "composer run logs:dev" "composer run vite:dev" "composer run schedule:dev" --names=server,queue,logs,vite,schedule --kill-others
prod: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74,#818cf8" "composer run serve:prod" "composer run queue:work-prod" "composer run logs:dev" "composer run vite:dev" "composer run schedule:work-prod" --names=server,queue,logs,vite,schedule --kill-others
scripts.serve:dev: while true; do taskset -c 0-3 php artisan serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3050; echo 'Server stopped. Restarting in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
scripts.queue:dev: while true; do taskset -c 4 php artisan queue:listen --tries=1; echo 'Queue worker stopped. Restarting in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
scripts.logs:dev: while true; do taskset -c 5 php artisan pail --timeout=0; echo 'Logs worker stopped. Restarting in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
scripts.vite:dev: while true; do taskset -c 6-7 npm run dev; echo 'Vite stopped. Restarting in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
scripts.schedule:dev: while true; do taskset -c 8 php artisan schedule:work; echo 'Scheduler stopped. Restarting in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
scripts.serve:prod: while true; do taskset -c 0-3 php artisan serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3050 --no-reload; echo 'Production-mode Server stopped. Restarting in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
scripts.queue:work-prod: while true; do taskset -c 4 php artisan queue:work --tries=3 --timeout=1200 --memory=512; echo 'High-performance Queue worker stopped. Restarting in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
scripts.schedule:work-prod: while true; do taskset -c 8 php artisan schedule:work; echo 'Production Scheduler stopped. Restarting in 10s...'; sleep 10; done
